name: Dreadlines
source:
One unemployed morning, an email lands in your inbox: You got the job! You don't know the company or remember applying, but you've been jobless for too long.

Dreadlines is a monster office dating sim about connections, deadlines and falling for your undead coworkers. Answer emails, survive small talk, that sort of thing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146570/Dreadlines/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在某个失业的清晨，一封邮件落进了你的收件箱：你被录用了！你既不认识这家公司，也不记得自己投过简历，但你实在已经失业太久了。

《Dreadlines》是一款怪物职场恋爱模拟游戏，讲述人际交往、截稿死线，以及与不死族同事坠入爱河的故事。回回邮件、熬过闲聊寒暄，诸如此类。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146570/Dreadlines/]Steam[/url]]
